---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for the project
title: "feat: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear and concise description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated
when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Alternative solutions or features you've thought about, including existing
workarounds.

**Scope fit (optional)**
Does this fit the project's direction? nextjs-crm aims to be a complete but
self-hostable CRM: contacts, companies, leads, pipeline, tasks, email
outreach, reporting, RBAC. If your idea is a large feature, consider opening
a [Discussion](https://github.com/sana-ullah305/nextjs-crm/discussions)
first.

**Additional context**
Screenshots, mockups, links, or examples from other CRMs.
